root_idea.summary: The root centers on singleness: being one, separate, or without a counterpart.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of unity and non-pairing, the lexicon develops meanings of being alone, set apart, individually distinguished, unequalled, and separated from others.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form فَرْد.
فُرَادَىٰ is the Quranic individually/one-by-one form associated with the citation headword فَرْد.

senses.definition: Single, alone, or solitary; without another joined with or accompanying it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, this describes a person or entity left without a companion, counterpart, or associated partner.

senses.definition: Individually; as separate individuals, one by one.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the plural-like expression فُرَادَىٰ for people appearing or being considered separately, including in contrast with pairs or groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Devotion to the study and observance of religious law while withdrawing from the rest of humanity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun associated with dedicated religious practice and retreat from worldly company.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a female to bring forth one offspring only.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explicitly used of a female, including a pregnant female, ewe, she-goat, or woman, in opposition to bearing twins.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a person or thing single, sole, or one only.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put apart or separate, or to reserve something exclusively for one person without a share for others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may take مِنْ to express separation from another, or بِـ to express exclusive allocation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform the pilgrimage rites separately from the rites of the minor pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional pilgrimage construction: أَفْرَدَ الحجَّ عن العمرةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send a messenger separately to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs with إِلَيْهِ in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become alone, apart, or independent of others, without anyone sharing in an affair, possession, or opinion; also, to be alone with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VII use with constructions such as بِنَفْسِهِ, عَنْهُ, بِفُلَانٍ, بِالأَمْرِ, or بِالمَالِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die, figuratively described as a bodily part becoming separated from the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed-tropical idiom in which separation of the neck from the body represents death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find a person or thing alone, with no second alongside it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X use of discovering someone or something isolated from its companions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or select something alone, by itself, or out from among accompanying things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X use expressing isolation or selection from a set.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Without equal or like; unmatched or unequalled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May qualify God as the One without counterpart, or an object such as a sword as unequalled in excellence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Apart, separate, unconnected, or unmixed with others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use for persons, animals, plants, or things existing separately from their group or kind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One member or half of a pair or couple.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use referring to one of two paired members.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Alone together with another person, apart from the rest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual expression فَرْدَيْنِ describes two people encountered without others present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bright star or group of stars standing apart from surrounding stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An astronomical and traditional star-name usage, including stars around the Pleiades or near Ḥaḍār.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One side of the jaw.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun with the plural أَفْرَاد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sandal with a single sole, not patched or doubled with a second sole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of sandal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bull, apparently a wild bull.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested animal-name use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicology, material transmitted by only one lexicologist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term distinguished from material reported by only one Arab informant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who goes away alone after leaving companions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal noun for one departing separately from a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hills or similar elevations, especially isolated mounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun for formations described as آكَام.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pearl or precious, highly valued gem; specifically, a bead that separates other beads or pieces of gold in a necklace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical association is with something precious and exceptional, or with a pearl set apart among other elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vertebra in the intermediate or projecting part of a horse's back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical anatomical term for the vertebral region between the dorsal and lumbar areas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who sells or makes فَرِيد, namely beads or separated necklace elements.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun derived from the specialized pearl-and-necklace sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of sugar: of the finest and whitest kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use in the expression سُكَّرٌ فَارِدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of she-camels: not resembling, or possibly not desired by, the stallions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source records a textual reading uncertainty: the transmitted explanation gives عدم resemblance, while a proposed correction yields عدم desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single or simple word whose parts do not each express a corresponding part of its meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional term in grammar and lexicology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A simple medicinal substance, used without being compounded with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical medical use, especially in the plural مُفْرَدَاتُ الطِّبِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild bull.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-name use of the active-participial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female that gives birth to one offspring only.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explicitly used of a female, pregnant female, ewe, she-goat, or woman, in opposition to one bearing twins.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of pieces of gold in a necklace: separated from one another by pearls or other فَرِيد elements.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of divided necklace components.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rider who has no other person with him, or who has only his camel with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a solitary traveler.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who withdraws from people to devote himself to religious observance, or one devoted to frequent remembrance and praise of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a transmitted religious expression, the term is also explained as referring to those who remain devoted to God's praise after their contemporaries have died.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicology, expressions uttered by only one Arab informant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term distinguished from أَفْرَاد, which concerns transmission by only one leading lexicologist.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The basic state of becoming single is covered by the Quranic solitary sense.
Making a person or thing single.
Exclusive allocation without a share for others.
Being alone, independent, or alone with someone.
Quranic solitude and broader separation or lack of mixture.
Specialized noun for isolated hills or mounds.
Pearls, necklace separators, and precious gems.
Maker or seller of pearl necklace elements.
Specialized adjective for fine white sugar.
Specialized she-camel usage with a recorded reading uncertainty.
Technical term for a simple word.
Religious devotee or frequent celebrant of God's praise.
Technical term for an expression reported by one Arab informant.

cautions: The specialized فَارِد description of she-camels preserves a source-reported reading uncertainty: the transmitted explanation concerns resemblance to stallions, while a proposed correction concerns whether stallions desire them.
